name: CE_RECON_EXCEPTIONS
description: CE_RECON_EXCEPTIONS contains information about reconciliation exceptions.

columns.name: RECON_EXCEPTION_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table.  Uniquely identifies each row in the table.

columns.name: STATEMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Bank statement line of the possible match pair.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Bank statement to which the statement line belongs.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the transaction in the possible match pair.

columns.name: RECON_MATCHING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Recon matching rule used for automatic reconciliation.

columns.name: RECON_TOLERANCE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Recon tolerance rule used for automatic reconciliation

columns.name: EXCEPTION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the exception. For example, amount exception (AMT), date exception (DAT), or ambiguous exception (AMB).

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Supplementary identifier of the system transaction from a source like Oracle Fusion General Ledger that uses composite keys.
